page.notes: Greek passages are transcribed from a blurred scan; the Greek accents and several words are uncertain and marked [?] where they could not be read with confidence. The line "ἀπεξαλφάμην" and the line beginning "ὡς τέτταρα" are the least certain. The last line of the main text ends at the bottom; the word "ὀλίγα" below it is treated as the catchword.
